frontText: Navy 57 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Africa
items.placementTarget: Board, over sub-Saharan Africa and Madagascar.

cities.name: Khartoum
cities.graticule: North of the printed 0° line. The printed 20°E meridian passes through the name, west of the disc.

cities.name: Kinshasa
cities.graticule: Just south of the printed 0° label on the west coast, west of the 20°E meridian.

cities.name: Dar es Salaam
cities.graticule: East coast, just south of the printed 0° tick. Population 2 square is inland, west of the disc.

cities.name: Antananarivo
cities.graticule: On Madagascar, near the printed 20°S line. Population 2 square is in the channel west of the disc. No rat.

cities.name: Johannesburg
cities.graticule: South of the printed 20°S line and just east of the printed 20°E meridian. No rat.

printedRoutes.notes: A black land line enters from the west edge of the sticker and ends in the Kinshasa disc. Lagos is the starting-board city in that direction; its name is not printed on this sticker.

redRegionLines: A short vertical red line leaves the southern tip of Africa and runs south into the ocean along the printed 20°E meridian.

mechanics.notes: Khartoum, Kinshasa, and Dar es Salaam are yellow and printed infested. Antananarivo is a black port. Johannesburg is blue and inland. Only Dar es Salaam and Antananarivo are ports. The only printed route is the supply line into Kinshasa from the west edge.

summary: Africa map. Khartoum and Kinshasa are yellow inland population 1, both infested. Dar es Salaam is a yellow port at population 2 and infested. Antananarivo is a black port at population 2. Johannesburg is blue, inland, population 2. A supply line runs from the west edge into Kinshasa. A red region line drops south from the Cape along 20°E. No recon box.
